@drawBracket.description: Section title over a knockout competition's rounds.

@drawStandings.description: Section title over a round-robin table.

@drawMatches.description: Section title over a round robin's matchdays.

@drawFinalStandings.description: Section title over a finished competition's placings.

@drawMatchday.description: A round of a round robin.

@drawWinnersRound.description: A round of a double elimination's winners bracket.

@drawLosersRound.description: A round of a double elimination's losers bracket.

@drawGrandFinalReset.description: The deciding grand final, played when the losers' finalist wins the first.

@drawToBeDecided.description: A bracket slot whose player isn't known yet.

@drawNoOpponent.description: A bracket slot no one will fill: the match that fed it ended without a winner.

@drawPenalties.description: A level knockout match's shootout, home first.

@drawRemoved.description: A player disqualified or withdrawn after the draw; their results stand, unranked.

@drawPlacing.description: Screen reader label for a final placing's number.
